versions.content: If the SOME/IP TP module detects an inconsistency of the received SOME/IP TP headers (i.e.: Request ID, Protocol Version, Interface Version, Message Type or Return Code are not equal for all received segments), • The current assembly process shall be interrupted as defined by SWS_SomeIp Tp_00054. • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_INCONSISTENT_HEADER.
